name: EURO3
oneLiner: EURO3 is 3A DAO's overcollateralized euro stablecoin, minted on Polygon and Linea against whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in user-owned vaults.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: 3A documents EURO3 as minted through collateralized vault loans and burned on repayment or redemption. That live stabilization path is a CDP mechanism, not issuer cash issuance or a NAV fund share; its reference remains the euro rather than the U.S. dollar.

collateral: Whitelisted crypto and stablecoin collateral in 3A Vaults on Polygon and Linea, including USDC.e, DAI, WETH/ETH, USDT, WBTC, wstETH, and other wrapped or yield-bearing assets depending on chain
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized vault minting and redemption: users mint EURO3 loans against approved collateral, repay debt to burn EURO3, and can redeem EURO3 against vault collateral when the protocol's redemption conditions are met

notices.title: Live collateral mix not modeled
notices.message: 3A documents the approved vault collateral set and redemption mechanics, but no Pharos-supported live adapter or stable public mainnet collateral-composition feed was found during this addition.
